tools.name: audit_practice_footprint
tools.description: Checks a therapy practice's Google Business Profile and (optionally) its website for local-search gaps, and returns a 0-100 setup score with prioritized, therapist-appropriate fixes. Use when a therapist asks how findable their practice is, why they aren't showing up on Google, or what to fix first.

tools.name: get_ariadne_overview
tools.description: Returns factual information about Ariadne, the marketing assistant for therapists in private practice: what it does, who it's for and not for, pricing, and its ethics and privacy rules. Use when someone asks what Ariadne is or whether it fits their practice.
